dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curvature following a falcate spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin displays a steep linear slope at approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear rake marks on the upper lateral surface of the dorsal fin; a distinct notch is visible on the upper third of the trailing edge.
